name: taster
description: Search Taster's library of Hebrew-first, RTL React components and whole sites, and add their original files to a project.

interface.longDescription:
Taster is a curated library of Hebrew-first, right-to-left React components and whole-site templates: heroes, buttons, cards, pricing sections, galleries, animated sections and complete multi-section sites, built for Israeli brands.

Search the library in Hebrew or English, then get a component's original source files, npm packages and sample assets with instructions to add them to a project unchanged, so the design arrives exactly as it looks on the site. In Codex the files go straight into the project; in a ChatGPT conversation the code is returned in the chat. Whole sites and single components can also be committed file for file into a private GitHub repository the member connects through the Taster GitHub App.

Using the tools needs a Taster account; members sign in with Google.
defaultPrompt: Search Taster for a Hebrew pricing section.
Show me Taster's hero sections that work in RTL.

positive.description: Search the library for a component type
positive.prompt: Search Taster for a pricing section.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of Taster pricing components with their ids, names and whether each is Free or Pro.
Returns carousel components from the library; Hebrew queries match the same items as English ones.

positive.prompt: Get the Taster component pricing-table and show me how to add it to my React project.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the component's original source files, its npm packages and step-by-step instructions to add it unchanged. Counts as one delivery for the account.
Returns the whole-site templates (for example Kedem) with their ids and a short description of each.

positive.prompt: Which GitHub repositories have I connected to Taster?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the private repositories connected through the Taster GitHub App, or, when none are connected, returns the Taster page where the member connects GitHub.
